raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Gallop over walls and get increased movement and attack speed after being deployed" Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History 5 Trivia 5.1 Comparisons Summary [ ] The Stick Horse is the fourth Epic piece of Hero Equipment for the Barbarian King . It made its debut in the Wise Warriors medal event starting February 9, 2026. The Stick Horse appears as a stick consisting of a white horse head on top with a brown strap on its nose and a dark yellow mane with orange tips covering its eyes. When equipped, it creates a yellow aura and leaves behind a trail of its matching color, allowing the Barbarian King to jump over Walls and lets him move and attack faster for a while when deployed. In addition to the ability, the Stick Horse gives the Barbarian King additional damage and hitpoints. Strategies [ ] Offensive Strategies [ ] In general, the Stick Horse is a direct upgrade over the Rage Vial , it provides more than twice the maximum hitpoints compared to the health recovery of the Rage Vial and almost twice the passive damage increase. For the ability, the duration last three times longer, despite only having around half of the movement speed increase and the damage per second multiplier is much smaller (damage increase for Rage Vial, attack speed increase for the Stick Horse), the longer duration and higher passive damage increase make up for it. The only downside being it always activates at the start of the battle and usually is not active in the core of a base. There are different interactions when pairing this with other Hero Equipment: When paired with the Giant Gauntlet , with the help of Angry Jelly , it allows the Barbarian King to enter a compartment and complete destroy it with the ability giving extra attack speed, splash damage, and damage reduction. The damage Hero Boost of both Equipment adds up and provides a massive boost, while Stick Horse provides the most maximum hitpoints of all of the Equipment of the King to tank the damage all by himself which pairs well with the self-healing per second from Giant Gauntlet. In addition, using a Rage Spell allows him to deal much more damage because of its longer rage duration, destroying high-hitpoint buildings like Storages and merged defenses with ease. Beware of Monoliths and Single-Target Inferno Towers as they can still do major damage even with the Giant Gauntlet's damage reduction. Defensive Strategies [ ] Defending against the Barbarian King's Stick Horse ability may be difficult, but it can be countered effectively by opening up a Wall in a compartment. When this happens, the Barbarian King will go to a much longer distance around the walls to reach his target instead of jumping over them. This allows defenses time to quickly deal damage to him before he causes too much destruction. Monoliths , single-target Inferno Towers and Revenge Towers (in its final stage) can quickly whittle out the hitpoints of the Barbarian King, even when his Giant Gauntlet ability is used. Traps like Spring Traps and Skeleton Traps can also help in this regard, though the former deals reduced damage to the King as he is a Hero and the latter is ineffective if the King is using the Giant Gauntlet. Clan Castle troops like Witches can overwhelm the King, provided that if he is not equipped with the Giant Gauntlet, they will outrange him while their summoned Skeletons can overwhelm the King with the help of other high-damaging defenses. If the King is equipped with the Giant Gauntlet, the splash damage combined with the increased movement speed and attack speed will easily kill the Witches. Trivia [ ] The Stick Horse is released to celebrate the Year of the Horse of the Lunar New Year. When the Equipment is initially unlocked and equipped to the Barbarian King, he attacks every 1.176 seconds for 12 seconds when the ability is active. When maxed out, he attacks every 0.902 seconds for 30 seconds. When the ability is active with the max-leveled Vampstache , he can attack every 0.774 seconds; with the max Snake Bracelet , he can attack every 0.839 seconds. Comparisons [ ] The Hero Boost of the Stick Horse provides damage increase on par with the Spiky Ball and more maximum hitpoints than the Snake Bracelet, which is the biggest increase for the Barbarian King for both stats. The Stick Horse is the second Equipment theme around the Chinese Zodiac of the year, the first being Snake Bracelet. The Stick Horse is remarkably similar to the Haste Vial , the only differences being the stats and the Stick Horse having a hitpoint increase Hero Boost and the Haste Vial having an attack speed increase one. The ability even gives the Barbarian King the ability to jump over Walls like the Royal Champion. The Stick Horse and Noble Iron are the only passive Equipment that provides a temporary, ability-like effect, which activates when deployed instead of using the ability. The Snake Bracelet is technically temporary as well with the Snakes spawned being capped, but the effect is much less dramatic compared to them.
